title: Freya and the Harbor
author: Sebastian Almeida
blurb: Xanthe Thackeray, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
